title: Hygiene: orphaned or self-referential test data (test/fixtures/chainConfig.ts and the two Mythril sample reports are imported by nothing, three integration tests cite chainConfig.ts as the chain template source, the Flashbots bundle factories are only smoke-tested, and one wsPush case asserts that a mock it just called was called)

evidence.note: no import of chainConfig.ts anywhere; the Mythril samples are referenced by no test or script (scripts/check-mythril-report.ts has no test)
header: inline Phase 4 types that "mirror the planned ChainConfig"
comment cites "chainRegistry.ts:204 / test/fixtures/chainConfig.ts:62" as the ETH gas template (also v2HoneypotIntegration.test.ts:233, v3HoneypotIntegration.test.ts:245)
createMockBundleResponse / createMockFlashbotsProvider: referenced only by test/unit/helpers.smoke.test.ts typeof checks
chain_status_change case calls the mocked broadcast and asserts it was called
comment: teardown is handled by setup.ts; the file "exists for documentation purposes" and exports nothing (vitest.config.ts:36 names only setup.ts)

sibling_sites_checked: Every file under test/fixtures and test/helpers checked for an importer at the base SHA (git grep on each export name): api.fixtures, exitEngine.fixtures, receipt.fixtures, tokenSafety.fixtures, mockProvider and testDb are used; chainConfig.ts and the Mythril samples are not; the two Solidity fixtures are compiled by hardhat.config.ts and used by the fork tests.
severity_rationale: S4: dead or tautological test material; misleading but harmless.
recommendation: Phase 28/29: delete chainConfig.ts (point the comments at chainRegistry.ts) or make it the single fixture source; either add a unit test for scripts/check-mythril-report.ts that uses the two samples or delete them; delete the tautological wsPush case.
